title: Notification Settings
description: Learn how to configure email, SMS, and push notifications to stay informed about important events in your store.
content:
Notification Settings

Configure email, SMS, and push notifications to stay informed about orders, payments, inventory, and other important events.

Notification Types

Configure different notification types:

  • Email notifications
  • SMS notifications
  • Push notifications
  • In-app notifications

Order Notifications

Get notified about orders:

  • New order received
  • Order status changes
  • Payment received
  • Order cancelled
  • Order refunded

Inventory Notifications

Stay informed about inventory:

  • Low stock alerts
  • Out of stock notifications
  • Inventory updates
  • Stock level changes

Customer Notifications

Customer-related notifications:

  • New customer registration
  • Customer inquiries
  • Review submissions
  • Newsletter subscriptions

System Notifications

System and account notifications:

  • Account updates
  • Security alerts
  • System maintenance
  • Feature updates

Email Notifications

Configure email notifications:

  • Enable/disable email types
  • Set notification frequency
  • Choose recipients
  • Customize email templates

SMS Notifications

Set up SMS notifications:

  • Enable SMS service
  • Configure phone numbers
  • Select notification types
  • Set SMS limits

Push Notifications

Enable push notifications:

  • Browser push notifications
  • Mobile app notifications
  • PWA notifications
  • Notification permissions

Notification Preferences

Customize notification preferences:

  • Notification frequency
  • Quiet hours
  • Notification channels
  • Priority levels

Managing Notifications

Manage your notifications:

  • View notification history
  • Mark as read/unread
  • Delete notifications
  • Notification filters

Best Practices

  • Enable important notifications
  • Set appropriate frequency
  • Use multiple channels
  • Review notification settings regularly
  • Test notification delivery
  • Keep contact information updated

Related Guides

  • Company Settings
  • Security Settings
meta_description: Guide to configuring email, SMS, and push notifications to stay informed about important events in your store.
